message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to the current clock, so I can’t give you the exact time right now.  
If you need the precise time in New York City, you can:

* Check a reliable world‑time website (e.g., timeanddate.com, worldtimebuddy.com).  
* Use a smartphone or computer clock set to the “Eastern Time” zone.  
* Call a public API such as the World Time API (`http://worldtimeapi.org/api/timezone/America/New_York`) to get the current timestamp programmatically.

Those sources will give you the exact local time, including any daylight‑saving adjustments.
